messages:
customer_alan: Hey team — we rotated our API key this morning and now 25% of prod requests are getting 401s. Only affects eu-west. No code changes. Logs show `invalid_api_key` from auth service.

sophie_support: sorry about that — can you confirm how the rotation was done? vault CLI / console / helm chart? any recent deploys?

customer_alan: We ran our usual helm upgrade that calls our rotation job (jobs/rotate-apikey). It writes a new k8s Secret with name like app-apikey-<ts> and updates Vault. No deliberate deploy after that.

ravi_sre: curious — did the helm job update the Deployment spec or just created a new Secret? If the Deployment still references the old secret name in env var valueFrom, pods will keep using old key until rolled.

customer_alan: ah — that might be it. Rotation job created a brand new secret name. We expected the vault-agent sidecar to pick it up. The vault-agent logs show a write to /etc/secrets/apikey but then later the sidecar logs: `watcher: no change detected for path /secret/data/service/apikey`

jen_prodeng: can you paste the pod env snippet and the deployment annotations? also paste the output of `kubectl get pods -n prod -o=jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.spec.containers[0].envFrom}{"\n"}{end}'` if possible.

customer_alan: gist pasted: `env: - name: API_KEY valueFrom: secretKeyRef: name: app-apikey-20260314 key: token`  The new secret is `app-apikey-20260315`. No rollout was triggered.

sophie_support: there you go. Root cause is the rotation job creating a new secret object name instead of updating the secret referenced by the running Deployment. Because the Deployment's spec still points to the old secret name, pods retained the old key. A couple of additional factors made it look intermittent:
- our edge-proxy caches token validation for ~60s, so some requests still passed for a short window
- vault-agent sidecar caches files and will only reload on path content changes; since the path/name changed, the watcher didn't see updates for the existing mount

ravi_sre: quick repro steps for ops team:
1) helm upgrade that creates new secret name (new suffix) without patching Deployment
2) verify pods still reference old secret with `kubectl describe deploy app-prod -n prod | grep -A2 API_KEY`
3) requests gradually fail as old key revoked in Vault/KMS

sophie_support: short-term mitigation options:
- kubectl rollout restart deployment/app-prod -n prod (forces pods to pick up new secret)
- create a new k8s Secret with the old name that contains the new token (aliasing) until you change rotation strategy

jen_prodeng: longer-term fixes we recommend:
- rotate in-place: update existing k8s Secret object instead of creating new-named objects, or
- include a checksum annotation on the Deployment that rotation job updates to trigger an automated rollout on secret change, e.g.:
```
kubectl patch deploy app-prod -p '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"secret-checksum": "$(sha256sum secret.yaml)"}}}}}'
```
- update rotation job to call the Kubernetes API to patch the Deployment or trigger a rolling restart after promoting the new key

customer_alan: I applied `kubectl rollout restart` and errors dropped to 0 after ~20s. Thanks. Any notes about Vault/KMS? We used KMS rewrap so the key-id changed upstream.

ravi_sre: noted — if you use KMS rewrap + new secret name, make sure any file-watcher-based sidecars are configured for the path pattern, or write to the same file path. Vault-templates that templated to `/etc/secrets/apikey` will reload if the file content changes in-place; creating a new secret object that mounts to a different path can bypass the watcher.

vault-bot: Incident created: SUP-2026-0915 — root cause: rotation job created new k8s Secret name, Deployment still referenced old secret leading to revoked tokens in running pods. Recommended remediations listed in thread. SLA: P2, owner: devops/rotation.

sophie_support: adding final checklist for runbook update:
- change rotation job to update secret in-place or patch Deployment checksum
- add post-rotation validation: curl internal health + auth check gateway with new token
- monitor 401 spikes for 5m post-rotation and auto-kick rollout if >5%

customer_alan: appreciate the help — will implement checksum rollout and change rotation job. Closing once we finish CI change. :thumbsup:
